deployments_detail.use: AI + big data + industrial IoT across pig-production stages (smart feeding, disease detection); intelligent devices to lower farming cost
Inspection robots for 24/7 monitoring of livestock
AI feeding systems and intelligent environmental controls

Muyuan AI Xiaomu (牧原AI小牧), an AI agent built on Alibaba Cloud's Qianwen (Tongyi Qianwen) large language model. Farm workers upload a short video or a recording of a pig coughing and the agent returns a disease diagnosis and medication recommendation in ~1 second (vs. a prior half-day wait for a vet). It also produces farm/batch operational-performance reports and answers internal knowledge questions. Trained by five senior veterinarians correcting its outputs over months. [Alibaba Cloud (Qianwen / Tongyi large model)]
deployments_detail.value: Deployed across 1,000+ farms with ~23,000 daily calls; raised pig survival rate by 1.5%; +19.6 yuan additional profit per pig; extended one vet's coverage from 100,000 to 300,000 pigs

deployments_detail.use: Strategic partnership with Alibaba Cloud (signed 1 June 2026) to jointly co-develop a full-scale 'pig farming industry large model' (养猪大模型) — a data-driven 'digital brain' spanning breeding, disease control and environmental management, intended to eventually be opened/shared with the wider industry as a universal farming assistant. [Alibaba Cloud (Qianwen large model)]
deployments_detail.value: Muyuan plans ~10 billion yuan over a decade in AI R&D, targeting ~600 yuan per-head cost reduction

deployments_detail.use: Self-developed intelligent environmental-control system with four-layer air-inlet filtration maintaining ICU-grade air quality in the multi-story Neixiang complex barns to prevent disease transmission, automatically regulating ventilation and climate for each pen. [Muyuan (self-developed)]

Self-developed intelligent/precision feeding systems that automatically adjust feed formula and quantity by pig age and weight along the feed lines, part of the fully automated production chain at the Neixiang smart-farm complex. [Muyuan (self-developed)]

Self-developed intelligent inspection/patrol robots that autonomously navigate the multi-story pig houses 24/7 to monitor pig health and farm conditions, replacing manual inspection rounds and enabling very high worker-to-pig ratios. [Muyuan (self-developed)]

Large-scale IoT / big-data platform (a farming 'digital brain') connecting the full supply chain of intelligent devices — environmental control, feeding, inspection and cleaning equipment — feeding data analytics that underpin Muyuan's AI systems. [Alibaba Cloud IoT]
deployments_detail.value: 3.33 million intelligent equipment units across the supply chain generating ~2 billion data points per day

deployments_detail.use: 'Smart Muyuan' (智慧牧原) digital employee/collaboration platform built on Alibaba DingTalk, unifying communication, ERP integration and multi-device workflow for the company's large workforce across all farm sites. [Alibaba DingTalk]

AI 'pig doctor' cough/voiceprint disease-detection system: microphones and sensors installed in pig houses collect cough sounds (and images) to perform preliminary automated diagnosis of respiratory diseases such as pneumonia and blue-ear disease, flagging sick pigs early.
